_comment: One of the three D'ni survey reports (design 7.6), each an Age the Guild of Maintainers turned down for
missing one thing a D'ni city needs, found with that Age's descriptive book so the reader can go and see
why. Each is a table of its own, because a pool draws one entry however they are grouped, and a nested
table drops everything it rolls. Their home is the lost library; until it exists they are scattered
into the vanilla chests nearest to one in spirit, rarely. Even odds between the three.
